motivation.purpose: High-diversity synthetic persona seeds for business persona generation.
research_questions: Can synthetic persona seeds provide rich behavioral priors for simulated user interviews?

composition.slice_description: Systematic stride-8 sampling over all 200,000 records from persona.jsonl yielding 25,000 uniformly distributed persona seeds across occupations, demographics, and behavioral archetypes.
composition.sensitive_content: Synthetic persona descriptions; may reflect demographic stereotypes present in foundation model outputs.

collection.upstream_creator: Tencent, HKUST, Tsinghua (Scaling Synthetic Data Creation with 1B Personas, arXiv:2406.20094)
collection.collection_mechanism: Generated synthetically by GPT-4 / Llama-3 / Qwen from web text anchors.

preprocessing.cleaning_applied: Extract persona text, normalize whitespace, apply systematic stride-8 sampling, assign deterministic UUID, validate non-empty string.

intended_uses: Grounding and seeding BebshaX persona generation (Phase 8).
prohibited_uses: Commercial redistribution without upstream license compliance

distribution.license_notes: Synthetic outputs from GPT-4/Llama-3/Qwen; downstream users must also comply with foundation model service terms.
